taxon.wikipedia_summary: Deutzia pulchra, the beautiful deutzia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydrangeaceae. It is native to Taiwan and the Philippines. A deciduous shrub reaching 2.5 m (8 ft), it is readily available from commercial suppliers.
